controls.yaw: head surface turn, degrees; nonlinear contour deformation plus face parallax
controls.squash: head/torso squash, ratio; reciprocal width compensation
controls.earL: upright ear bend, degrees, attachment locked
controls.earR: folded ear bend, degrees, attachment locked
controls.smile: eye arch from neutral wedge to soft laugh crescent, 0..1
controls.pawL: left paw offset [x,y] in source px
controls.pawR: right paw offset [x,y] in source px

notes: No mouth or eyebrows, including hidden controls: explicit user direction.
Head-only and full-body compile the exact same head subtree from character.svg.
Black eye wedges are the pupils in this character; no white eyeballs are invented in neutral.
Original round paws intentionally float beside the body. Animation preserves this visual convention.
Ear roots overlap the skull by 25–45 source px. Foot tops are rebuilt under the torso.
Ear rotation is implemented as a progressive bend around named pivots, with both root edges fixed.
Black outline widths are constant source-space values. There is no stroke-width animation.
